rationale: Pre-implementation review with ll:advise Opus 5.5 (confidence 0.8). Amends decision 6820b86c-53dd-4007-aa75-9269d6a94044 within Option B: both byte columns are NULL on every replay write, while ctx_stats already recognizes either non-NULL byte column as telemetry. The narrower wipe preserves output-only rows without retaining replay rows. NULL correction sources survive. Materialize normalized survivor keys to avoid quadratic FTS matching; recorded in the rewritten issue.
rule: Option B amendment: wipe tool_events only when bytes_in IS NULL AND bytes_out IS NULL; wipe user_corrections only when source = backfill; preserve existing search entries by normalized survivor keys; no migration
alternatives_rejected: Channel migration adds no information for legacy rows; bytes_in-only wipe unnecessarily deletes output-only telemetry; timestamp precision is not a valid provenance signal
